posts.zh:
dsh-pdf 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-950d30ae770d2f9237af.html
posts.en:
dsh-pdf is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-950d30ae770d2f9237af.html
